name: s0_saved
note: The sheet's own saved state. Manual allocation takes the whole supply, so the strategy pool is empty.

name: s1_pool_only
note: No manual allocation, so the whole supply flows through the greedy pool. This is the path the saved state never exercises.

name: s2_split_manual
note: Manual and pool both active, across three states, with a supply large enough to fund many geographies.

name: s3_thresholds
note: Thresholds bite, so the threshold strategy is gated to a subset. Program parameters all changed too.

name: s4_short_duration
note: Six-to-eleven months, two-month duration. Duration below three months zeroes the effect, so impact should be zero while allocation is unaffected.

name: s5_oversupply
note: Supply exceeds total national need, so every geography must be funded to exactly its own need and nothing more.

name: s6_tight_thresholds
note: Severe thresholds plus a ward-level view, testing the gate at the row level rather than in aggregate.
